turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi. I'm learning English and I want to read a novel. Which is good for me?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Great goal. Graded readers are a good start, they're real stories written with simpler words for learners.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I read some already. I want a real book now, not for students.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then try a short modern novel with lots of dialogue. Conversations are easier to follow than long descriptions.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should I use a dictionary for every word I

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Try not to. Only look up words that come back again and again, or that you need to understand the scene.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay. And if I don't understand a whole page?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Read it once more, then keep going. You'll often understand it a few pages later from the story.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thank you, that helps. I'm a little nervous.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's normal. Your English is already strong, you'll enjoy it more than you think.
